# text = Mount the Theta Arm to the Gantry Robot.
# text = Install the seal (P/N 4471-20) in the Hydraulic Pump Assembly.
# text = Remove the Main Control Panel from the frame.
# text = Torque the bolts to 25 N·m.
# text = Clean the surface with a dry cloth.
# text = Lift the Z-Axis Carriage with a hoist.
# text = Turn the knob clockwise until it stops.
# text = Set the pressure to 3000 psi.
# text = Lock the Theta Arm in position.
# text = Support the load with a jack.
# text = Position the bearing in the housing.
# text = Attach the cable to the Gantry Robot.
# text = Record the readings in the log.
# text = Do not touch the hot surface.
# text = WARNING: Do not operate the motor without the guard.
# text = Make sure that the valve is closed.
# text = Make sure that the arm does not touch the frame.
# text = If the indicator light comes on, stop the motor.
# text = Flush the system with clean fluid.
# text = Bleed the air from the brake line.
# text = Tap the housing lightly to seat the bearing.
# text = Run the pump for 5 minutes.
# text = Connect the lead to the terminal.
# text = Do not use a damaged seal.
# text = Tighten the nut by hand, then torque it to 12 N·m.
# text = Apply grease to the mount.
# text = Remove the mount from the Theta Arm.
# text = Check that the seal is not cracked.
# text = Set the Hydraulic Pump Assembly to the OFF position.
# text = Mount the robot arm and slide it home.
# text = Mount the wild horse and ride it home.
